title: Experiments: audio-first cues (keysound, call and response, play by ear)
subject: docs/experiments.md: list setEnemyPoseFilter with the other arena hooks

mappings.label: INSTRUMENTS
mappings.description: Each move plays a part: block = 808, slash = lead (your synth patch), stab = hats/perc, flourish = vocal chops. A miss mutes or glitches that part.

mappings.label: SWORD SFX
mappings.description: Moves make sword sounds; the song plays as written.

mappings.label: B · PRODUCER FX
mappings.description: Each move is a mix-wide effect: BLOCK pumps, SLASH sweeps a filter, STAB stutters, FLOURISH lifts into the next bar. Misses fumble the effect.

mappings.label: C · HYBRID
mappings.description: Moves play instruments (808, lead, hats, vocal chops); a clean combo measure fires a production flourish at the bar line.

experiments.label: BASELINE · 4 LANES
experiments.description: The current game: four lanes on the floor, cues scroll to a hit line.

experiments.label: TELLS · READ THE ENEMY
experiments.description: No highway, no icons: the enemy’s wind-up is the cue, always one beat before the hit.

experiments.label: PARRY · DIRECTIONAL DEFLECTS
experiments.description: Every cue is a strike from a side: press that direction on the beat to deflect it.

experiments.label: ONE LANE · COLUMN
experiments.description: One central lane through the enemy: badge colour and shape say which key.

experiments.label: ONE LANE · TAIKO STRIP
experiments.description: One horizontal track at the enemy’s chest: badges slide onto the enemy, Taiko style.

experiments.label: CONVERGE · BADGES ONTO THE ENEMY
experiments.description: No lanes: cue badges fly in from around the enemy and land on its chest on the beat.

experiments.label: APPROACH RING · ON THE ENEMY
experiments.description: No lanes: a ring shrinks onto the spot of the enemy you must hit and closes on the beat.

experiments.label: KEYSOUND · YOU PLAY THE SONG
experiments.description: The cue notes are cut from the song: only your hits play them, on the beat.

experiments.label: CALL & RESPONSE · ANSWER THE ENEMY
experiments.description: The enemy plays a one-bar phrase; you play it back in the next bar. No highway.

experiments.label: BY EAR · SOUND CUES ONLY
experiments.description: No highway, no icons: every move is announced by its own sound a beat ahead.
